issues.message: conformal PEC is enabled on faces ['y_hi', 'y_lo', 'z_hi', 'z_lo'] with a min cell size 1.000 mm <= 2 mm — this is a KNOWN NaN (discrete-adjointness break, not CFL; 4 fix methods falsified — tracked at https://github.com/bk-squared/rfx/issues). normalize=False is NOT a safe workaround at fine dx. Use conformal=False (staircase PEC) or a coarser mesh (dx > 2 mm) until the contour-FIT redesign lands.

Waveguide port 'left': declared y-width 22.8600 mm is not what this grid rasterizes (dx=1.0000 mm): the port's slice covers 23.0000 mm, and the solve builds its mode template and cutoff from 23.0000 mm. Cutoffs, |S| references, and any analytic comparison computed from 22.8600 mm describe a structure this run does not solve. Choose dx so it divides the declared width, or declare the width the grid can represent.
